messages:
incident-bot: Alert: Elevated 95th latency and error rate for model family marlin9b in prod-east. Auto-surge detector opened a mitigation thread.

samir: Paging oncall. I'll own initial triage. seeing CPU hot shards, KV cache miss spike.

olivia: Thanks Samir. Any customer-facing impact?

samir: Affected traffic = ~6% of global requests. Errors are user-facing 502s for some large-context requests. High p95 token timeouts.

mike: Propose immediate temporary per-model throttle: reduce marlin9b TPM from 60 -> 12 and RPM from 300 -> 60. Keep for 15m then reassess. This should drop pressure on KV/cache.

jin: Agree. Also recommend disabling function-calling and structured-output on marlin9b to reduce heavy inference paths.

luis: If we go that route we need to create a fallback routing rule so customers get a compatible model variant (tangram7b-small) instead of errors. I can push the route change.

olivia: OK owners: Samir (triage + runbook), Luis (routing changes), Mike (quota ops), Jin (feature toggle). Tess please prep customer notice if this is prolonged.

samir: Runbook steps I'm running now: check shard load, check kernel oom, evict large KV segments. Post results in 10m.

mike: Executing quota change now: `quotactl set --model marlin9b --tpm 12 --rpm 60 --duration 15m --reason "live-surge-marlin9b-prod-east"`

ops-bot: quotactl: successfully updated marlin9b TPM=12 RPM=60 (applied to prod-east). Effective immediately.

luis: Pushing routing fallback: `routectl add --from model=marlin9b --to=tangram7b-small --filter=region:prod-east --priority=high`

route-bot: routectl: fallback route added. Traffic will be diverted for 5% of marlin9b-origin requests when quota tripped.

jin: Feature toggles: disabling function-calling and structured-output for marlin9b in prod-east: `feature-toggle disable marlin9b function_calling,structured_output --region prod-east`

feature-bot: toggles applied.

samir: Early signs: p95 latency dropping, error rate trending down. KV miss rate lower after eviction.

olivia: Good. Keep quota at lowered level until we confirm stability for 30m. If stable, we can try a cautious ramp: 12 -> 24 TPM.

mike: Noted. I'll monitor TPS, p95, and throttle events. Alert thresholds set to auto-escalate if error rate >1% for 5m.

tess: Draft customer note prepared: short blurb + ETA. Will send if we extend beyond 30m.

samir: Status check in 10m and again at 30m. Handoff plan: if stable after 30m, Olivia will close thread. If not stable, escalate to eng-runtime.

olivia: Thanks all. Please add any console links or logs here. samir — paste shard IDs.

samir: Shards impacted: pe-04a, pe-04b, pe-07c. Logs: https://console.internal/logs?query=marlin9b+pe-04a (bookmark for oncall).

mike: Observability: token throughput back to baseline, throttle events decreased by 78% after quota change.

incident-bot: Reminder: this thread will be archived unless updated.

samir: Updating runbook: marking mitigation steps taken and owners. Will reopen if we see regression.

olivia: Closing plan: keep reduced quotas for 30m, attempt staggered ramp if stable. If we need to rollback, use `quotactl set --model marlin9b --tpm 60 --rpm 300` and re-enable features.

luis: I'll follow up with a quick post-incident summary and recommend longer-term mitigations (cache warmers, smaller kv segments, and preflight budgeting for heavy function-calls).

tess: I'll queue a support note for affected customers once we hit 30m.

samir: 30m check: system looks steady. p95 within SLO, error rate <0.2%. Ready to start ramp to 24 TPM.

mike: Ramping: `quotactl set --model marlin9b --tpm 24 --rpm 120 --duration 30m --reason "ramp-after-stabilize"`

ops-bot: quotactl: marlin9b TPM=24 RPM=120 applied.

olivia: Thanks team. I'll close this thread after 1h post-ramp if stable and file a short postmortem doc.

samir: Leaving notes in the runbook and will follow up on long-term fixes.

mike: Marking mitigation resolved in monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated — no customer-facing errors.

olivia: Closing now. Thanks everyone :tada:
